Title: Where the Water Waits
Alt_Text: A moody marsh landscape painting showing water moving through a tidal marsh with muted sky light.
Tags: marsh landscape painting; tidal marsh wall art; coastal landscape painting; original oil painting; marsh water painting; gallery wrap canvas art
Colors: slate blue; blue-gray; lavender-gray; muted blush; creamy white; deep marsh green; charcoal
Description: The water moves quietly through the marsh beneath a broad, layered sky. Pale channels catch the available light and turn through the darker land in long, unhurried curves. Loose brushwork keeps the surface visible, allowing the changing light to carry the atmosphere.
Story: The water held the last pale light in its bends while the marsh settled into deeper green.
Subject: Winding water channels through a marsh beneath layered cloud cover
Light_Description: Cool, diffuse light filtered through layered cloud cover; pale highlights along water channels and lower cloud edges; muted lavender and blush notes.
